description: The source describes a code effective September 1996 for foundries outside the stated approval requirement. It identifies controls on air-emission opacity, particulates, fugitive dust and industrial runoff, plus monitoring of baghouses or wet scrubber dust collectors. Environmental logs and incident reporting are also specified. This is process-specific operating information for manufacturing infrastructure. The metadata does not supply numerical emissions thresholds, equipment performance data or a simulation model. Current amendments and the named publisher terms remain unverified because the legal body was not fetched. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
